    • getItemInHandDropChance

      float getItemInHandDropChance()
      Gets the chance of the currently held item being dropped upon this creature's death. 获取该生物当前手持物品在其死亡时掉落的概率。
      • A drop chance of 0F will never drop
      • A drop chance of 1F will always drop
      掉落概率为 0F 时永不掉落；为 1F 时必定掉落。
      返回:
      chance of the currently held item being dropped (1 for players) 当前手持物品的掉落概率（玩家恒为 1）

    • setItemInHandDropChance

      void setItemInHandDropChance(float chance)
      Sets the chance of the item this creature is currently holding being dropped upon this creature's death. 设置该生物当前手持物品在其死亡时掉落的概率。
      • A drop chance of 0F will never drop
      • A drop chance of 1F will always drop
      掉落概率为 0F 时永不掉落；为 1F 时必定掉落。
      参数:
      chance - the chance of the currently held item being dropped 当前手持物品的掉落概率
      抛出:
      UnsupportedOperationException - when called on players 当对玩家调用时
